(() => { const t = document.querySelector('[aria-label="Game log"]'); const rows = [...t.querySelectorAll('[role=row]')].slice(1); const cell = (r, i) => r.querySelectorAll('[role=cell]')[i]?.textContent; const num = (s) => Number((s ?? '').replace(/,/g, '').replace('−', '-')); const games = rows.filter((r) => cell(r, 0) !== 'Total'); const total = rows.find((r) => cell(r, 0) === 'Total'); const col = { PTS: 5, REB: 6, AST: 7, STL: 8, BLK: 9 }; return JSON.stringify({ games: games.length, sums: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(col).map(([k, i]) => [k, [games.reduce((a, r) => a + num(cell(r, i)), 0), num(cell(total, i))]])), first: games[0]?.innerText.replace(/\n/g, ' ') }) })()
